description_en: Queries a paginated list of regular expression rule groups
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-rule-groups --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRuleGroups

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The query type. Valid values:

id: Queries by rule group ID.

name: Queries by rule group name. Both Chinese and English names are supported
parameters.help_zh:
查询类型。取值：
id:   表示按照规则组ID查询。
name:  表示按照规则组名字查询，支持中英文查询
parameters.name: search_type

parameters.help_en: The page number of the results to return. The default value is 1, which returns the first page of results
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为1，表示返回第1页数据
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. The default value is 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页包含多少条结果。默认值为10，表示每页包含10条结果
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

RuleGroups.description_en: The list of regular expression rule groups

items.description_en: The list of regular expression rule groups

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the rule group was last updated

IsSubscribe.description_en:
The automatic update status of the rule group.

1: Automatic updates are enabled.

2: Automatic updates are disabled
IsSubscribe.description_zh:
规则组自动更新状态。

1：表示自动更新。

2：表示不自动更新

ParentRuleGroupId.description_en:
The ID of the rule group that the current rule group inherits.

0: The rule group is created from scratch and does not inherit from another rule group.

1011: The Strict rule group.

1012: The Medium rule group.

1013: The Loose rule group
ParentRuleGroupId.description_zh:
规则组继承的规则组ID。

0：表示不继承，从零创建。

1011：表示严格规则组。

1012：表示中等规则组。

1013：表示宽松规则组

RuleGroupId.description_en: The ID of the rule group

RuleGroupName.description_en: The name of the rule group

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
